summary: The agent read the requirements and design, then filed a single design proposal covering REQ-002 AC3 (done tasks must look visibly different). Its reasoning is that no existing class renders tasks, so it proposed a browser-side task list view with a ticked checkbox and struck-through text, re-rendered at the end of the mark-done sequence (SEQ-003). Before approving, check whether a new view component is acceptable scope for P3 and whether the proposal conflicts with the current sequence diagram.
